producer: Microsoft Word for Mac 16.113.3 (layout via File > Save as PDF, AppleScript); DOCX inputs generated by script from word-mac-two-section-notes-source.docx

files.word-mac-probe-settings-sectend-next-pag: settings.xml w:endnotePr/w:pos=sectEnd; two sections (nextPage); section 1 has 14 long endnotes, section 2 has 2
files.word-mac-probe-settings-sectend-continuo: same with a continuous section break; 3 + 2 endnotes
files.word-mac-probe-sectpr-only-pos-ignored.d: pos=sectEnd only inside each sectPr/w:endnotePr (settings.xml unchanged)

findings: Word ignores sectPr-level w:endnotePr/w:pos: with no settings.xml position every endnote still lands at the end of the document (probe sectpr-only-pos-ignored).
With settings.xml pos=sectEnd each section's endnotes follow that section's last paragraph (same 36pt offset as the document-end area).
A nextPage section break starts the next section on a new page after the previous section's notes, even when the notes run onto several pages.
A continuous section break lets the next section continue on the same page directly after the notes.
Numbering is continuous across sections by default (i..xvi in the probe).
Word splits a long note paragraph at line level across pages; GenOffice moves whole entries (same simplification as its document-end area).
layout: word-mac-layout-lines.json (y positions in pt from the page top of the note label / first note line / body lines)
